services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Nothing compares to being out on the water as the last rays of sunlight go down at the end of a perfect summer day. Kick back, relax, and enjoy a scenic sunset cruise in the stern of our boat. Maybe you have a destination you’d like to visit, or maybe it is all about the journey. Either way, we’ll drive the boat, and you enjoy Maine as it should be experienced: on the water. Each 2-hour tour accommodates up to 6 people. Price is per group. All ages are welcome. blurb: Guests participate in educational and experiential boating adventures including learning boat operation, lobstering, wildlife observation, and scenic cruises. Programs are led by experienced, certified guides and educators. Tours accommodate small groups and include opportunities to learn about local marine ecology and fisheries.
